name: uv__get_loop

ownership.argument: Returns the calling thread's default loop, creating it at task-info +136 on first use. A module that can call this needs no NuttX structure walk at all, which is why this target's dispatch should bind it instead of re-deriving the q66 chain.

provenance.source: Calls uv__tls_get 0xC2DEA38, loads task-info +760 (0x2F8), and on zero runs uv_loop_init 0xC2DC9A0 on task-info +136 and stores that address back at +760. A second caller 0xC2DDF94 uses the same slot while walking the loop's handle list.

notes: The lazy-create path is also the proof that the loop lives inside the TLS block rather than in a uv_key-indexed state array.
